page.layout: One page of running text in a single justified column. Running head top left, page number top right. A gathering signature "O" stands at the foot, left of centre. No margin notes, no footnotes, no catchword.

main_text.p: acta censeantur. Præses, Hovetmanni, scribę à secretis, accensi, in fide sint utriusque partis pari modo, nullo præcipuo civitatis iure præter Hovetmannorum electionem & officii limites ab utraque parte iis præscribantur. Præses & Hovetmanni solam jurisdictionem tractent in causis solitis ab anno M. D. XXI ad annum M. D. LX, potestatem reliquam magistratus, & politicum regimen agri non attingant: agrariis liceat separatim suos conventus habere in causis ad ipsos seorsim sine civitate pertinentibus. Ordines hujus provinciæ, Ordines urbis Groningæ, & Omlandiæ, agrarios solos Omlandios inter Amasum & Lavicam appellare, rectum sit. Agrarii vectigalia nulla, mercatus solennes, trutinas publicas instituant sine consensu Ordinum provinciæ omnium: agrariorum postulatum de subdivisione tributorum & onerum inter civitatem & agrum adhuc non audiatur: interim quod in onerum modo, quem pro rato provincia hæc tenetur sustinere, ex tributis & censibus jam usitatis solvi non potest, id conficiatur ex quintâ censûs aut proventûs omnium bonorum immobilium, agrorum pariter & adi-ficiorum,

page.notes: The running head "Groningæ" and the æ are read from a small scan and may be slightly off. The final word is split across the line end as "adi-" / "ficiorum," and is joined here as printed. The "O" at the foot is treated as a gathering signature. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout, so "Amasum" and "sustinere" are as set.
